test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Simplify: 

3p - [3p - overline{p+q} - {3p - (p - overline{q-p})}]
solution:
**Given: **

3p - [3p - overline{p+q} - {3p - (p - overline{q-p})}]

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

As the over bar removes the negative becomes positive and vice-versa but only those signs which are under it. 

3p - [3p - overline{p+q} - {3p - (p - overline{q-p})}]

So the new equation will be

3p - [3p - p - q - {3p - (p - q + p)}]

⇒ 3p - [3p - p - q - {3p - (2p - q)}]

⇒ 3p - [3p - p - q - {3p - 2p + q}]

⇒ 3p - [3p - p - q - {p + q}]

⇒ 3p - [3p - p - q - p - q]

⇒ 3p - [p - 2q]

⇒ 3p - p + 2q 

⇒ 2p + 2q

**∴ The simplified value of given equation is 2p + 2q.**
